content:
The Laredo Police Department says a large fire at North Central Park forced an evacuation on Wednesday morning, and the park is closed until further notice.

Police posted the alert at 10:26 a.m. on Oct. 28, saying the park was being evacuated and would remain closed until further notice. The department did not say what caused the fire or whether anyone was hurt.

Residents should avoid the area and follow police directions while crews respond. Details remain limited as the situation develops.
